settings.headline: Accessibility statement
settings.subtitle: We want every member to be able to use this website, including people who use screen readers, keyboards, magnification or captions.

settings.headline: Our commitment
settings.body:
We design and test this website against the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2, level AA.

What we do

  • Every page has a skip link, landmarks, a logical heading order and a visible keyboard focus.
  • Rate tables use real table markup with headers, so screen readers can read them row by row.
  • Text and buttons meet AA contrast, and nothing depends on color alone.
  • Documents are available in large print at any branch.

Known issues

Some older PDF disclosures are not fully tagged. Call us and we will read them to you or send an accessible copy.
settings.side: If something on this site does not work for you, call (555) 014-2000 or email access@kestrelvalley.example. We answer within two business days.
